dedupe_keys.name: so2sat pop part 1 population image patches

description: The TUM So2Sat team publishes Part 1 of its population-estimation benchmark as European city image patches. The own mediaTUM page makes two ZIP files available under CC BY 4.0. The article describes Sentinel-2 seasonal imagery, local climate zones, night lights, land use and OpenStreetMap-derived features linked to population counts or classes. These patches can test spatial population inputs for urban service-demand or evacuation simulations after a suitable estimation model is trained. A caveat is that patch labels and city-based train/test splits do not guarantee accuracy in a new country or settlement type. Part 2 contains additional elevation and raw OSM inputs under a different share-alike licence, so rights must be kept separate. I read the own mediaTUM metadata and article Data Records without downloading the large files, training a population model or checking every city split. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
